text: An oracle concerning Moab: Ar in Moab is ruined, destroyed in a night! Kir in Moab is ruined, destroyed in a night!

on the roofs and in the public squares they all wail, prostrate with weeping.
their voices are heard all the way to Jahaz. Therefore the armed men of Moab cry out, and their hearts are faint.
her fugitives flee as far as Zoar, as far as Eglath Shelishiyah. They go up the way to Luhith, weeping as they go; on the road to Horonaim they lament their destruction.
